text:
sam: Quick spin-up for tomorrow's launch — want to run X + LinkedIn cadence. Plan: 09:00 X thread (3 tweets), 09:15 LinkedIn post, follow-up thread at 12:00 for ENG highlights. Also routing inbound signups to SDR queue. Thoughts?
elaine: love it. confirmed we need hero gif + 2 screenshots + 1 short clip. who owns assets?
morgan: I got the hero gif + screenshots. clip needs a 6s edit — can do by EOD today. filenames: riff-hero.mp4, riff-shot1.png, riff-shot2.png
javier: routing: can we send hot leads (trial signups with utm=launch) straight to sdr-high? anything else to flag?
priya: copy variants: A = product-first, B = benchmark-narrative (latency/cost wins), C = webinar-invite CTA. Prefer we A/B test tweet 2 between A/B.
sam: yes on A/B for tweet 2. Javier — confirm mapping: utm=launch&src=x -> sdr-high, utm=launch&src=li -> sdr-warm?
javier: correct. Also add tag "benchmark" for anyone coming from the benchmark thread so ops can trigger case studies.
morgan: uploading assets to GDrive: https://drive.redwood/example/riff-launch (public-to-marketing). I'll drop final clip by 18:00.
elaine: can you export hero at 1200x628 and 1080x1080? LinkedIn wants 1200x627 ideally.
morgan: yep — exporting both. will include png + webp.
priya: copy for tweet thread draft: 1) "We just cut model infer costs by 32% for streaming workloads." 2) "Why that matters: latency stays < 200ms while cost drops." (A/B alt: "Benchmarked: same quality, 32% cheaper.") 3) CTA -> webinar link + signup. Keep it tight.
sam: webinar link is https://redwood.ai/riff-webinar?utm=launch — add ?variant=A/B per test. Also add UTM_source param.
social-bot: scheduled message created: channel=#x-redwood at 09:00 for tweet-thread-draft-3487654321. (use `/schedule post`) :white_check_mark:
priya: small ask — can we include 1 stat image (latency vs cost) as tweet 2 image for higher CTR? Morgan can you quick-mock?
morgan: I can. will do chart png: latency-cost-compare.png by 17:30.
javier: SDR routing note: make sure webhook includes `lead_score` and `utm_source`. Example payload we need: `{"email":"...","utm":"...","lead_score":...}`. sdr-bot will tag priority.
sdr-bot: webhook validated. any lead with lead_score >= 80 + utm=launch -> queue: sdr-high. lower -> sdr-warm.
elaine: asset checklist so the scheduler can go live: hero mp4, shot1/2 png, chart png, short clip mp4, copy variants A/B/C, final landing url with UTMs.
sam: timeline recap: assets finalized by 18:00, social-bot posts at 09:00 + 12:00, LinkedIn 09:15. Javier to confirm webhook mapping by 16:00. Priya to lock copy by 16:30. Morgan to upload everything by 18:00.
priya: I'll do copy + a 1-line opening for LI (long form) and 2 short intros for X.
javier: I'll run one quick test webhook with sdr-bot now.
sdr-bot: test passed — sample routed to sdr-high (lead_score 92, utm=launch, src=x).
morgan: uploaded latency-cost image + final clip to Drive. links in thread.
elaine: thanks — I'll schedule final posts once I see the final clip. can someone drop the final CTA landing url with tracking?
sam: final url: https://redwood.ai/riff-webinar?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=riff_launch
priya: one more: follow-up engagement plan: replies with product questions -> @sales-assist, replies with pricing -> auto DM pricing sheet + route to sdr-warm. Use template: "Thanks! Want the pricing sheet? Here's a quick PDF: <link>. Want a demo slot?"
javier: noted — add `question_type` classifier to webhook (simple keywords). we'll log and iterate.
sam: awesome. if nothing blocks we'll greenlight at 20:00 tonight. thanks team :rocket:
